headline.label: Rainfall
headline.verdict: MAE 38.0% lower than equal-weight ensemble (95% CI 33.3–42.5%); MAE 32.0% lower than inverse-error weighting (95% CI 27.0–36.6%); MAE 38.7% lower than train-selected best model (95% CI 35.3–42.3%); also beats the test-selected oracle best model

headline.label: Temperature
headline.verdict: MAE 34.3% lower than equal-weight ensemble (95% CI 33.2–35.3%); MAE 24.2% lower than inverse-error weighting (95% CI 23.4–25.1%); MAE 35.5% lower than train-selected best model (95% CI 34.6–36.3%); also beats the test-selected oracle best model

headline.label: Wind speed
headline.verdict: MAE 15.0% lower than equal-weight ensemble (95% CI 14.3–15.7%); MAE 10.2% lower than inverse-error weighting (95% CI 9.5–10.8%); MAE 28.5% lower than train-selected best model (95% CI 27.7–29.3%); also beats the test-selected oracle best model
